title: Base Power button
description: Square-shouldered 8px buttons in a semibold grotesk: a lime fill with forest text, a forest hairline outline for light bands, and a light hairline outline for photo bands. Colours shift over 0.15s on hover and a trailing chevron nudges right.
notes: ghost follows the foreground colour: use it inside a dark-scoped photo band
lime hover lightens on light bands and deepens slightly over photos (it fades the fill)
